infoTravel.title: Info Travel
infoTravel.description: Discover comprehensive information about destinations, history, culture, transportation, and cuisine in Manado and surrounding areas.
infoTravel.historyDesc: Manado has a rich history with unique Minahasa cultural heritage. Explore historical sites and local traditions that are still preserved today.
infoTravel.transportDesc: Various transportation options available to facilitate your journey, from private car rentals to tourist buses for groups.
infoTravel.foodDesc: Enjoy Manado's signature dishes like Tinutuan, Cakalang Fufu, and various fresh seafood from North Sulawesi waters.

paketTour.title: Tour Packages
paketTour.description: Choose the best tour packages to explore the beauty of Manado and its surroundings
paketTour.minahasaDesc: Explore the beauty of Minahasa highlands with colorful lakes, ancient waruga, and stunning mountain views.
paketTour.bunakenDesc: Enjoy the underwater beauty of Bunaken, one of the world's best diving spots with spectacular coral reefs.
paketTour.likupangDesc: Relax on Likupang's beautiful beaches with white sand and crystal clear water.
paketTour.manadoCityDesc: Get to know Manado city better by visiting important landmarks and local shopping centers.
paketTour.tomohonDesc: Visit the cool city of Tomohon and hike Mount Mahawu volcano with stunning crater views.
paketTour.customDesc: Design your journey according to your preferences with the help of our professional team.

hotels.title: Hotels & Resort
hotels.description: Find the best accommodation for your comfort during your stay
hotels.luxuryDesc: 5-star hotels with complete facilities, swimming pool, spa, and spectacular ocean views.
hotels.boutiqueDesc: Hotels with unique design and personal service providing exceptional stay experiences.
hotels.beachDesc: Beachfront resorts with direct beach access, water activities, and relaxing tropical atmosphere.
hotels.budgetDesc: Economical options with basic comfortable facilities, suitable for backpackers and budget travelers.
hotels.familyDesc: Hotels with family-friendly facilities, spacious rooms, kids' play areas, and family packages.
hotels.businessDesc: Hotels with complete business facilities, meeting rooms, fast WiFi, and strategic locations.

testimoni.title: Testimonials
testimoni.description: What our customers say about their travel experience with Maleosan Travel
testimoni.review1: Amazing experience! The Maleosan Travel team is very professional and friendly. Minahasa Highland tour package is highly recommended.
testimoni.review2: Bunaken snorkeling trip was amazing! The coral reefs are beautiful and guides were very knowledgeable. Highly recommended!
testimoni.review3: Car rental with driver was very helpful. The driver knows the best tourist spots and gave great food recommendations.
testimoni.review4: Family trip to Likupang was perfect. The beach is pristine and kids loved it. Great service from start to finish!
testimoni.review5: Custom tour package fits my budget. The team is very flexible and helps plan the perfect itinerary. Thank you Maleosan Travel!
testimoni.review6: Excellent service! The hotel recommendations were perfect and transportation was very comfortable. Will definitely come back!
